findings.evidence: focus.json: Tab lands on 'Visit Consile on SaaSHub', 'Visit Consile on Product Hunt' and 'G2 Peer reviews' at x = -3052 (off-screen copies of the scrolling marquee), and then on ~15 badge links all at y 1824; the marquee duplicates the list three times so keyboard users tab through the same links repeatedly, some invisible.
findings.after: Add aria-hidden="true" and inert to the duplicated marquee copies; keep one focusable set in view
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.3 Focus Order and 2.4.7 Focus Visible: focus moves to elements the user cannot see.

findings.evidence: The badge strip is an auto-scrolling marquee (tile 02 shows cards cut at both edges mid-scroll; text repeated three times in dom). No pause control visible.
findings.after: Add a visible pause button and stop the animation on hover/focus and under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide: moving content lasting more than 5 seconds needs a way to pause.

findings.evidence: Seven links read "Learn more" (SAML, SCIM, Audit Log Streaming, Privileged Access, Public API, Recurring Tasks), two read "Privacy" and one "View list"; out of context they do not say where they go.
findings.after: Learn more about SAML 2.0 Single Sign-On (or aria-labelledby the card heading)
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context) / 2.4.9 best practice.

findings.evidence: A fixed 'Install Consile' sheet covers the bottom third of the first phone screen, hiding the 'Explore the live demo' CTA below 'Start free'; it stays fixed while scrolling.
findings.before: Fixed install banner over the hero CTAs on first load
findings.after: Delay the prompt until after first interaction and render it in flow, or ensure focused elements scroll above it (scroll-padding-bottom equal to its height)
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum): a focused CTA can be hidden by author-created fixed content.

findings.evidence: 28 favicon images have alt="" while the adjacent text names the site (fine), but badge images carry promotional alts like "Consile - Run your business. All in one place. | Product Hunt" and "SaasHunt Top 1 Daily Winner" repeated 4x (duplicated marquee copies), so a screen reader hears the same badge list three times.
findings.before: Repeated badge alts in hidden-duplicate marquee copies
findings.after: Keep alts on the first set; aria-hidden="true" on the duplicated tracks
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.1.1 Non-text Content and 1.3.2 Meaningful Sequence: duplicated decorative copies add noise.

findings.evidence: Questions render as disclosure rows with only a chevron; cannot confirm aria-expanded from the capture.
findings.before: Accordion state shown by chevron only
findings.after: Use <button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-1"> inside an h3 for each question
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (state must be exposed). Not verified live; flagged for check.

strengths: Every nav link and CTA has a visible 2px orange outline on focus (focus.json).
Content images that carry meaning have descriptive alt text (video thumbnail 'Consile demo video thumbnail'); favicons beside text are alt="".
not_investigated: Keyboard operation of the mobile menu, FAQ accordion and video play button (no live Playwright run).
Forms: none on the landing page.
Sweep contrast hits on the orange accent words in the h1 ('in one workspace') look real in tile 00 (orange on peach gradient); not disputed.
